svg.title: Measured MFD controls across existing stock reset, issue 92
svg.desc: Two fresh pre-CMAC read-only sessions sampled twenty MFD control, placement and status words twice before and twice after the existing stock reset and DDR-idle checkpoint, before powerdown. All measured pairs and phases agree. Native MPEG-2 and H.264 recovery match frozen full pixels, EOS and cleanup. No custom MFD/SCL write, source pattern, START or pixel DATA read. Not a source/sink lease or consumer completion proof.
svg.text: MFD controls: paired read-only observations across stock reset
BCM70015 · two fresh sessions · pre-CMAC only · each cell represents two equal scalar reads
Cold tuple → checked existing reset / DDR idle → pre-powerdown tuple
All 20 observed words agree within each pair, across the two phases and across A / A′.
No custom MFD/SCL write · no source-pattern write · no feed START · no pixel DATA read
Opaque LINE_ADDR0 / defined STRIDE fields are not an allocation, address-unit or fetch-extent contract.
Native playback controls — not standalone MFD/SCL output
Full-byte canonical match · firmware EOS · pending 0
Display thumbnails: first control frame, YUY2→RGB, area-scaled to 192×108. Full-pixel comparison used raw buffers.
Both checked cleanups: 0 · retained=false · commands=0 · stock module restored · native EOS/cleanup PASS
Complete non-atomic tuple pairs, not a full MFD state snapshot or reset-default certificate.
Pending context persists through the whole stock stop and post-stop PCI checks; this is not a buffer lease.
No active-bank, pixel-unit, source extent, all-consumer completion or raw routing result is established.
Issue 92 stays open: standalone processing and practical non-native-codec backend reuse remain unproved.
